newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India issues Sept 23-27 leaded gasoline buy tender.
newsitem.headline: India issues Sept 23-27 leaded gasoline buy tender.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy 25,000 tonnes of 87 octane 0.15 leaded gasoline for delivery to Kandla on the west coast of India, traders said on Tuesday.
The tender which seeks the cargo for delivery between September 23-27, closes August 12 and is valid for a day.
IOC last week cancelled its last tender for a cargo for delivery between August 10-14 due to an overestimation of demand, an Indian source said.
IOC last purchased gasoline by tender in June due to a shortfall caused by the five-day emergency shutdown in early June of the 150,000-barrel-per-day Cochin refinery.

It bought one 25,000-tonne gasoline cargo for June 18-22 delivery at $43 per tonne over Mideast naphtha quotes and another at over $30 per tonne premium for June 26-30 delivery, both on a cost-and-freight basis to Bombay on the west coast, traders said.
